ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:6 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark-pigmented surface populated by numerous high-contrast white annular and circular pixel blobs. High-density clustering of white pixels is observed at the distal tips and along the trailing edge of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate 75-degree angle and a depth-to-width ratio of roughly 1:1.5.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with frequent sharp-peaked serrations; pixel-amplitude of valleys ranges from 5 to 15 pixels relative to the local edge baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge leading to sharply pointed and slightly recurved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely distributed white circular and ring-like clusters mapped across approximately 85% of the visible fluke surface, varying in diameter from 10 to 40 pixels.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short-axis, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions detected on the lower-left medial surface and mid-right lateral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Concentrated high-intensity white pixel mass at the extreme distal tip of the left lobe, indicating heavy scarring or calcified accumulation.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme density and uniformity of annular (ring-shaped) scar patterns across the entire fluke surface is a singular distinctive feature.
